description: Correlated-asset buckets for portfolio-cap rule enforcement. Tickers in the same bucket count as one allocation toward the per-bucket exposure cap — so a max-2-per-bucket rule prevents stacking three full-size crypto-L1 trades and calling it diversified. Source of truth for `rules.portfolio.bucket_for_ticker`. Edit and re-deploy; no DB migration required.

$resolution_rules.membership: a ticker belongs to at most one bucket (first match wins, ordering below is intentional)

buckets.label: Crypto L1
buckets.rationale: Top-tier blockchains move together on macro liquidity and BTC dominance shifts

buckets.label: Crypto alts / memes
buckets.rationale: High-beta to BTC; positioning concentration is a known account-killer

buckets.label: Precious metals
buckets.rationale: Gold + silver miners and spot move on the same real-rate / dollar driver

buckets.label: Uranium
buckets.rationale: Thin, correlated theme; positioning crowding is the risk

buckets.label: Tech megacap / AI
buckets.rationale: Index-like co-movement; QQQ is the same trade in a wrapper

buckets.label: Tech / growth indices
buckets.rationale: Composite tech beta; pairs with tech_megacap (operator decides whether to merge for cap purposes)

buckets.label: Broad-market beta
buckets.rationale: All beta to the same regime read

buckets.label: Defense / aerospace
buckets.rationale: Procurement cycle is the single driver

buckets.label: Rates / duration
buckets.rationale: All long/short the same yield curve
